title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau's Struggles
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau faces missing the cut in all four majors this year, turning down the PGA Tour's return offer from LIV Golf amid LIV's financial collapse, and risking becoming the only under-40 multi-major leader to miss every major cut in 2026.

items.headline: 2026 Open Championship Changes
items.text: The Open at Royal Birkdale features major course changes including a new par-3 15th and a 600-yard par-5 14th, challenging contenders as defending leader Scottie Scheffler seeks redemption after missing a cut for the first time since 2022.
